title: Want bigger arms? You probably don't need more exercises. You need better execution and progression.
hook: Want bigger arms? You probably don't need more exercises. You need better execution and progression.
caption:
Want bigger arms? You probably don't need more exercises. You need better execution and progression.

This is a simple, low-volume approach to training the triceps, biceps and shoulders with one goal: get as much productive work as possible from every working set.

The setup:

TRICEPS
→ Cable Pushdowns: 2 sets
→ Cable Overhead Extensions: 1 set

BICEPS
→ Machine Preacher Curls: 2 sets
→ Cable Hammer Curls: 1 set

SHOULDERS
→ Machine Lateral Raises: 2 sets
→ Machine Shoulder Press: 1 set

Most working sets are performed for 5-8 reps at ~1 RIR, with around 3 minutes of rest between sets.

title: FATIGUE ISN’T THE GOAL. ADAPTATION IS. 💪
hook: FATIGUE ISN’T THE GOAL. ADAPTATION IS. 💪
caption:
FATIGUE ISN’T THE GOAL. ADAPTATION IS. 💪

A workout doesn't become effective just because you leave the gym exhausted, sore, or unable to walk.

For muscle growth and hypertrophy, the goal is to create a sufficient training stimulus, recover from it, and progressively adapt.

🎯 Mechanical tension — challenge the muscle with resistance.
📈 Progressive overload — improve performance over time.
🔥 Effective effort — make your working sets sufficiently challenging.
🏋️ Quality volume — accumulate productive work.
🥗 Nutrition — support training and muscle growth.
😴 Recovery — allow your body to adapt.
